application_conditions: In-app referral code for existing Plasma One account holders with an active card in good standing; no publisher or affiliate programme found on plasma.org or the help centre.
paid_action: Qualifying referral = registration with the code, no prior Plasma One account, identity verification completed, card activated and an eligible purchase made. Then: referral cashback on the friend's spend, plus one-time spend bonuses and upgrade bonuses.
validation_conditions: Earning period starts when the friend redeems the code (not at first purchase); Lite and Core earn for 3 months, Platinum for 6 months. 'Applicable limits' apply, amounts not published. Users in excluded countries (list in the Help Center, not read) are not eligible for spend bonuses. No Platinum bonus and no XPL-lock Core bonus where referrer or referred user is a UK resident.

commission.model_note: Referral cashback by the referrer's tier: Lite 0.25%, Core 1%, Platinum 1% of the referred user's eligible card spend, paid in XPL. One-time spend bonuses (first-spend, high-spend) and Core/Platinum upgrade bonuses paid as Spending Credit; amounts 'in the Help Center' except the Platinum upgrade bonus stated as $300 in spend credit. Second-degree rewards: a percentage of second-level spend bonuses, one level only.
commission.tiers_note: Lite rate recorded as the base. The Platinum article still shows a 3% 'Platinum Referral Cashback Boost' (90 days or $300) that the referral article (2026-09-23) and the Addendum (2026-09-26) say is replaced by the $300 upgrade bonus for registrations on or after 2026-09-26.

payout.method: Referral cashback in XPL to the Plasma One account; bonuses as revocable Spending Credit (no cash value, cannot be withdrawn or converted, forfeited on account closure)
payout.frequency: Weekly (currently Thursdays), after a pending period of several days

rules_note: Governed by the Plasma One Rewards Addendum (effective 2026-09-26) and the Terms of Service (arbitration, class-action waiver). Programs may be modified or terminated prospectively. Operator Plasma states it is 'not a regulated financial institution'; card issued by Rain, accounts by Bridge entities. UK users: additional disclaimers at plasma.org/uk-disclaimer.
allowed_countries_note: Must reside where the Programs are available; excluded countries for spend bonuses are listed in the Help Center (not read). UK residents excluded from Platinum and XPL-lock Core upgrade bonuses.

evidence.title: Plasma One Rewards Addendum (effective 26 September 2026)
evidence.excerpt: Qualifying referral: registration with code, no prior account, ID verification, card activation. Referral cashback rate and cap by tier (Help Center); spend bonuses and upgrade bonuses as Spending Credit; second-degree rewards one level; Platinum Upgrade Bonus replaces the Platinum Referral Boost from 2026-09-26; UK exclusions.

evidence.title: How does referral cashback work? (help centre, 23 Sep 2026)
evidence.excerpt: Lite 0.25%, Core 1%, Platinum 1%; 3 months (Lite, Core) or 6 months (Platinum) per referral; paid weekly in XPL; $300 spend-credit bonus when a referred friend upgrades to Platinum, replacing the former 3% boost.

notes: Personal referral programme only: requires holding a Plasma One account and card, pays in XPL and non-withdrawable Spending Credit.
